# Project Location Two-Column Layout
The "项目坐落" field occupies two columns in a three-column grid to avoid misalignment of "统一社会信用代码" with "行政区划".

## Problem
- In an `el-row`, "项目坐落" occupied 16 grids, pushing "统一社会信用代码" to the third column misaligned with "行政区划"
- Edit mode needed vertical alignment of fields

## Solution
- Use `section-form` three-column grid in edit mode
- `section-field` for normal fields, `section-field--wide` for "项目坐落" (two columns), `section-field--full` for presale description (full row)

# Branch Detail Save Button Gating
AgencyBranchDetail.vue defines header-button gating so the "保存" button only appears in editable states, not in view mode.

## Problem
- Header button group did not limit editability by business state
- Branch detail view mode incorrectly showed the "保存" (Save) button

## Solution
- `AgencyBranchDetail.vue` defines `canEditInHeader` (B-end and bizState==='0' not deactivated)
- `showSaveButton` is true only when adding or `canEditInHeader` is true
- `isViewDisplay` is read-only when viewing or not editable, aligned with list page conditions

# Dual-End Bank Table Empty State
BankAccountTable.vue in two modules was unified with a Headline wrapper and a right-slot button for consistent empty state and alignment.

## Problem
- Bank tables in supervision/agreement/account and property/propertyAccount had inconsistent empty-state whitespace and button positions

## Solution
- Both `BankAccountTable.vue` files wrap content with `Headline` and move the button to the `#right` slot
- `:table-tr` binds data length to trigger `zs-table` compact empty state
- New props added: `titleText`, `showBalanceQueryButton`, `form`

# Conflito Vue2 mixin e componente na propriedade showListName
O mixin `listMixins` (table.js) define `data.showListName` e os componentes StateTable/PlanTable/LicTable redefinem o mesmo `computed`, gerando warning no Vue2.

## Causa Raiz
- `listMixins` (table.js) declara `showListName` em `data`
- StateTable/PlanTable/LicTable declaram `computed.showListName` com mesmo nome, conflitando com o mixin

## Solução
- Em `projectEmbeddedCertificateList.js`, o `watch` de `isEmbedded` define `showListName` do mixin como `!embedded`
- Remove os `computed.showListName` duplicados dos três componentes

# Vue2 Mixin showListName Conflict
The listMixins table.js declares data.showListName while StateTable/PlanTable/LicTable redeclare the same computed, triggering a Vue 2 warning.

## Root Cause
- `listMixins` (table.js) declares `showListName` in `data`
- `StateTable`/`PlanTable`/`LicTable` declare `computed.showListName` with the same name, conflicting with the mixin

## Solution
- In `projectEmbeddedCertificateList.js`, a `watch` on `isEmbedded` sets the mixin's `showListName` to `!embedded`
- Remove the duplicate `computed.showListName` from the three components
